description.ncbi_summary: Enables calcium ion binding activity; heparin binding activity; and kringle domain binding activity. Involved in bone mineralization and cellular response to transforming growth factor beta stimulus. Located in cytoplasm; extracellular space; and granular component. Part of collagen-containing extracellular matrix. Implicated in osteoarthritis. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Tetranectin binds to plasminogen and to isolated kringle 4. May be involved in the packaging of molecules destined for exocytosis. Plays a role in retinal function (PubMed:35331648).
